disclosure_triggers: real estate professional hours substantiation gaps

confidence_stratification.DEFENSIBLE: Clear material participation under test 1 (500+ hours), documented contemporaneous grouping election, per se passive rental with no exceptions
confidence_stratification.AGGRESSIVE: Material participation test 4-6 reliance, prior year participation aggregation, significant participation activity aggregation
confidence_stratification.DISCLOSURE: Regrouping without material change justification, self-rental recharacterization, limited partner material participation claim
confidence_stratification.HIGH_RISK: Undocumented grouping elections, real estate professional hours without logs, working interest misclassification

response_modes.FAST: Concise passive activity analysis with primary authority
response_modes.DEFENSE: Audit-ready passive activity position with substantiation requirements
response_modes.MEMO: Full IRC §469 analysis with multi-doctrine decomposition and fact fragility scoring
